arms.adjusted: analyze_trajectories with the six covariates, attribution and residual_correction df
arms.oracle: the primitive on X - z (x) (v / sigma): the exact injection removed in analysed coordinates
arms.unadjusted: the primitive on the analysed features (descriptive)

attribution.bootstrap_seed: derived per replicate from the base seed (shared by every arm and cell)

categorical.role: drawn (the D10 RNG stream is kept); neither declared nor injected

injection.scale: pooled feature SD on the analysed scale

rule.criteria: contamination: mean(adjusted - oracle) + k*SE <= contamination at every cell; residual confounding: |mean projection difference (adjusted - oracle)| + k*SE <= residual_confounding_ratio * |mean projection difference (unadjusted - oracle)| at every cell; truth precision, sign stability and top-k frequency: mean(adjusted - oracle) - k*SE >= their margin at both orientation cells
rule.descriptive: the unadjusted arm's criteria, the PLS-captured and residual components, the transition blocks and the readings conditional on angle rejection (adjusted arm, p <= alpha); none changes the verdict
rule.gates: contamination: mean(unadjusted - oracle) - k*SE >= contamination_gate at the anchor; projection: |mean projection difference (unadjusted - oracle)| - k*SE >= projection_gate at every cell; recoverability: oracle mean truth precision at orientation e = 1.0 >= recoverability_gate
rule.indicative: fewer than 999 permutations, 200 bootstrap replicates or 500 available replicates in any cell
rule.reading: observed component of the principal-orientation block
